answer: Escrowed dispute staking is a challenge bond: any identity locks 240 units for 15 epochs, and anyone may dispute it within 3 epochs by posting evidence. Nine jurors decide within 2 epochs. Proven forgery forfeits 80% of the bond, and 25% of the forfeit rewards the challenger. The kernel is the open challenge: no insider list, no permission. A forger who tries to wander through with 1,000 clones locks 240,000 units. A 30% detection rate forfeits 57,600 units and pays 14,400 units to challengers. The pulse is the bounty: every forged identity funds its own hunter.
